notes.title: Update 0.8.13
notes.content:
In this update are some often requested feature updates!

Worker Upgrades

How fast your factory gets built, is determined by the workers. They in turn have two stats that are relevant:


 Speed: how fast can they run around?
 Strength: how much can they carry at once?


The combination of this will determine how many roundtrips they have to make and how fast they can make them.

In this update, you can now upgrade your workers 5 times (through the right click menu if you have selected a single worker), each upgrade will make them faster and stronger. Upgrading them costs money as you need to train them!

Additionally, upgraded workers will require higher wages to stay content, they do offer more value to your factory after all.

Bulk Build

Previously you had to place each building one at a time by clicking. For most buildings this is OK, but for belts this can be a frustrating amount of work if you are building long chains of them.

You can now drag entire lines of buildings at once. This is very handy for planning long belts, but it can be used on any building!

Tiny update

A new shortkey has been added to clear belts (C).

notes.title: Update 0.8.12
notes.content:
Usability Tweaks

The biggest addition in this update is the realtime view of important key and mouse actions. This should make it a lot clearer what can be done and how.

Machines will now emit two new warnings:


 when you feed it a resource that is not in the recipe
 when you feed multiple valid resources from a recipe on a single input


Added two shortkeys:


 A shortkey to build ghosted items in your selection (B)
 A shortkey to open the help menu (H)


Two tiny UI tweaks:


 Added an "X" to the top right of explainer popups, just in case it is not evident how they are closed.
 Moved some of the buttons in the top menu to the right and added a label

notes.title: Update 0.8.11
notes.content:
Feature updates

[olist]
 There are now in-game popups that explain parts of the UI.
 Changed the starting conditions, you now start with some recipes unlocked and a basic factory as an example.
 Updated the tutorial
 If you run out of money now, you will be offered a chance to take out a loan. This loan is however at a much steeper interest rate.
 You can now choose to continue playing once you've reached the end goal.
 Buy containers will now periodically recheck when it is empty rather than checking once and (if you don't have enough money at that time) becoming inactive
 "Build ghosted" right click menu option is now available if you have any ghosted items in the selection
[/olist]

Tiny updates and fixes

[olist]
 Added a button to open the overview page to the top menu
 Added a shortkey to toggle global ghost behavior
 Updated descriptions on some buildings
 Added support for shift+scroll to scroll horizontally through your factory (ctrl+scroll is still vertical)
 Changed font sizes to be more stable across environments
 Fixed resize events which weren't triggering correctly on windows leading to things like floating hotbars
 Fixed issue where splitters/mergers might get stuck when placing new belts until a specific event occurred or the game was restarted
 Fixed a bug where a machine would not directly push resources to a sell container
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.8.10
notes.content:
Hotbar

The biggest change in this release is the addition of the "hotbar". You can configure up to 5 hotbars of 10 items each, you can cycle through the hotbars using "alt+scroll".

In the build menu, there is a new button "hotbar" that allows you to bind items from there to the hotbar.
Triggering the correct (configurable) key shortcut or clicking the hotbar with the mouse will allow you to build quicker.

Zoom

Because the zoom seems consistently hard to find, I switched it around: now scrolling is zooming in and out while ctrl+scroll allows you to scroll up and down the map. Alt+scroll cycles through the hotbars.

Blueprints

You can now remove global blueprints if you go to the build menu, check "show global blueprints" at the top, a "remove" button has been added next to the "import".

You can also update existing blueprints, which is a new option right next to "Create blueprint" in the right click menu.

Misc

- fixed a bug where decommissioned items are not always cleaned up entirely
- updated customizable keybindings to better support special keys
- updated the tutorial a bit and added the tutorial entries to the help screen so you can review them later

notes.title: Update 0.8.9
notes.content:
As requested, I've added a new toggle to the "Settings" screen that allows you to switch between full screen mode and windowed mode.

In this new version the steam overlay should also work!

notes.title: Update 0.8.8
notes.content:
Based on some of the initial feedback from players, I have added some improvements. More will follow soon!

One larger issue:

Some topics were unclear to players so I added a help section that you can access through a new help icon in the top menu or the "help" entry in the main game menu. I added some initial content to help explain certain mechanics of the game. Let me know which other topics might need further clarification!

Some Small issues:

- Some players reported flickering of the tooltips, this should be resolved. Some players also reported the screen behind it flashing, this was likely related to the tooltip and should hopefully be fixed as well.
- Added a "previous" button to the tutorial section (and other sections as well).
- Added an icon to access the planner.
- Added initial support for windowed mode (more on this soon).
